name: Agent Data Injection
description: Instructions placed in data an agent is explicitly tasked to process (issue comments, PR descriptions, CI logs, tickets, structured records) that exploit the agent's failure to separate trusted control data from untrusted content data during task execution.
differs: Distinguished from Indirect Prompt Injection (T1.002) by the trust boundary: the payload arrives through the agent's *primary task input* that the operator has designated as trusted-to-act-on, not through incidental retrieved content. Detection focuses on trust-label conflicts and control/data plane mixing rather than on hidden text.
